description: Intent i002 (BRANCH=and-presence-guard, SNAPSHOT=s01) complete. Two high-confidence findings in snapshots/s01 drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c, both identical-mechanism siblings of the seed's hwsim_del_edge_nl fix (commit 0303b30375df) that the fix did not cover: (1) hwsim_new_edge_nl() lines 421-425 — guard `if (!info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID] && !info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE]) return -EINVAL;` joins two negated presence tests with && instead of ||, so a netlink MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_NEW_EDGE message omitting exactly one required attribute passes validation; the missing attribute is then dereferenced at line 425 via nla_parse_nested_deprecated(edge_attrs, ..., info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE], ...) (NULL nested-parse deref) and/or line 431 nla_get_u32(info->attrs[...RADIO_ID]); (2) hwsim_set_edge_lqi() lines 531-544 — same inverted && guard at 531-533, NULL reaching nla_parse_nested_deprecated at 535 or nla_get_u32 at 542, PLUS a second nested instance of the same inversion at 538-540 over edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID]/edge_attrs[LQI] leading to unguarded nla_get_u32/nla_get_u8 at 543-544. Evidence: hwsim_genl_policy (lines 579-583) marks neither attribute NLA_REQUIRED and the genl ops (lines 604-622) use GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT, so the netlink core enforces no presence; untrusted source is the attacker-crafted generic-netlink message. Bounded negative evidence: 19 candidate guards triaged across the whole s01 tree (netfilter nft_tunnel/nft_tproxy, nl80211, nfc netlink, ieee802154 nl-mac/nl802154, xfrm_user, rtnetlink, lwt_bpf, ipv6 addrconf) — all classified safe because their && guards implement correct at-least-one semantics with individually presence-guarded uses. nft_tunnel_get_init (net/netfilter/nft_tunnel.c:79, tb[NFTA_TUNNEL_KEY]/tb[NFTA_TUNNEL_DREG] && guard with unguarded derefs at 83/95) is structurally identical but gated behind CAP_NET_ADMIN nf_tables NEWRULE parsing, so it was classified safe for this unprivileged-genl branch and left as an explicit limitation/candidate for the unchecked-tb-deref branch (i003). Limitations: pattern search bounded to direct `!attrs/tb[N] &&` indexing (no macro/boolean-indirection guards), no runtime repro executed, unprivileged reachability of hwsim asserted from the upstream CVE precedent rather than re-proven. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i002.json with execution_status=complete, snapshots_checked=["s01"], 2 findings, 19 candidates, 4 limitations.
